definitions.explanation: The turn to make a move in a board game or strategy game. Primarily used in shogi, go, chess, and similar turn-based games. Can also refer to the advantage of having the initiative or the right to move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手番|てばん}です。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手番|てばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I thought about my strategy during my opponent's turn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先手|せんて}→先手：10556_sente⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手番|てばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: In shogi, it is said that having the first turn is an advantage.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand; move) and ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (turn; order). Most commonly used in the context of ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ (Japanese chess) and ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧ (go), but also applies to any turn-based game including modern board games and video games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手番|てばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: for one's turn to come
- {手番|てばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to pass one's turn
- ⟦{先手|せんて}→先手：10556_sente⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手番|てばん}: the first player's turn
- {手番|てばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to waste one's turn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧: turn — more general; used in everyday contexts (⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧)
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧: order/sequence — refers to the ordering of turns rather than a single turn
- ⟦{先手|せんて}→先手：10556_sente⟧: first move/initiative — specifically the right to go first
